10001.story: As of Oct 16, cash rent in Kent County runs $119 an acre in 2026, highest of 3 in Delaware and up 33.0% from $90 in 2016. The census value of land and buildings was $8,679 an acre in 2022, up 9.5% from 2017 but lowest of 3 in the state. In 2022, 52% of the farmland here was rented.

10003.story: As of Oct 16, cash rent in New Castle County runs $102 an acre for 2026, up 8.5% from $94 in 2016 and the lowest of 3 in Delaware. The census value of land and buildings tells it the other way, at $11,212 an acre in 2022, up 18.0% from 2017 and the highest of 3. Dryland corn trends at 156.8 bu, also the highest of 3, and 72% of the farmland was rented in 2022.

10005.story: As of Oct 16, cash rent in Sussex County sits at $106 an acre for 2026, 2nd lowest of 3 in Delaware and right on the state median. That is up 19.8% from $89 in 2016. The census value of land and buildings came in at $9,642 an acre in 2022, up 13.8% from $8,473 in 2017. Corn made 184.9 bu in 2025, and 46% of the farmland was rented in 2022.
